review_notes: I read all 97 lines. The file has no new definitions, structures, classes or instances. It has two theorems: `KiAux.chart_unique` and `solution`. `chart_unique` shows that two ring homomorphisms out of `OriginChartRing W` that induce the same section are equal. It does this with `cancel_mono` and `Spec.map_injective`. It is a standalone lemma, not a competing concept, and the rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication. `solution` is the main result. It uses Mathlib's `IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal`, `IsAdicComplete`, `Ideal.span`, `PowerSeries` and `RingHom.ker`, and the project's own `FormalGroup`, `RelativeGroupLaw` and `Section` notions. I did not search for any of those project notions in Mathlib. I did not look for Mathlib alternatives to `chart_unique`, because it is a lemma and falls under the exclusion. Nothing here is a parallel version of an existing Mathlib concept.
